0.original: Vuyargur seeks a pair of burly biceps to do his bidding.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Speak with the culinary courier in Worlar's Echo.

25.original: Carry the stone box of foodstuffs to Garharlor.

48.original: Good timing, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. With the brawniest of my kin otherwise occupied with construction, I would prevail upon your strength.

49.original: Some time ago I sent a courier to fetch culinary supplies for the larder, but I suspect he may be too heavily encumbered.

50.original: If you could seek him out in Worlar's Echo, we would be most grateful for your helping hands.

51.original: Are you here to help me? Oh, thank the ancestors.

52.original: I was so giddy about the restoration of the larder, I went around telling everyone I could find, and they showered me in foodstuffs to bring back!

53.original: It seems everyone's keen to see us complete the restoration of Zirgorteh the Open-armed, for I've been given another mountain of foodstuffs to bring back!

54.original: Not to be ungrateful, but I can only carry about ten of these heavy stone boxes, and I'll need to walk slowly, lest I drop the whole stack down the mountain.

55.original: Think you could deliver one to Garharlor over in Shelter? Your muscles may not thank you, but everyone else surely will!

59.original: Heavy, aren't they? You'll get the hang of it! Here, try again!

61.original: Collect the stone box of foodstuffs from the culinary courier and deliver it here to Garharlor.

62.original: Ah, this must be the delivery I requested. Much obliged.

63.original: Let's see here. Corn, beans, popotoes...and spices too!? Why, the box is stuffed to bursting!

64.original: These are all pantry staples─ingredients commonly used in our most beloved Yok Huy soups. A generous offering indeed.

65.original: Mmm... Smell that? With this much sweet corn, no belly shall go unfilled.

66.original: Come to think of it, you weren't harassed by hungry alpacas on the road, were you? Perhaps we should be grateful that these stone boxes form an airtight seal...

67.original: This looks to be tulidile jerky─the perfect staple for a larder, given its long shelf life.

68.original: That said, I can't imagine something as delicious as jerky will go uneaten for long. Certainly not if I have the opportunity. <chuckle>

69.original: Right then, that will be all I require of you. Speak to Vuyargur for your reward!

70.original: Go and collect your reward from Vuyargur. You've earned it, my friend!

71.original: Enjoyed some light exercise, did you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Rest those weary arms for as long as you like─but first, accept your reward with my thanks.
